# SEO generator emits doubled /news/blog/blog/<slug> paths in sitemap.xml

## Context

While auditing `https://neomjs.com/sitemap.xml` and `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs` (`2026-10-24`) to diagnose Google Search Console indexing failures with `@tobiu`, we discovered that all 20 internal blog routes in `sitemap.xml` and `llms.txt` carry a doubled `/news/blog/blog/<slug>` path prefix.

**Sweep Attestations (`ticket-create §1a`):**
- `Live latest-open sweep:` checked latest 20 open issues in `neomjs/neo` (`#19145`–`#20086`) and `neomjs/middleware-v2` (`#9`–`#34`) at `2026-10-24T01:07:10Z`; no equivalent open ticket found.
- `A2A in-flight claim sweep:` checked latest 30 messages (`status: 'all'`); no competing claim on `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs`.
- `MC sweep:` `query_raw_memories({query: "middleware-v2 Googlebot Search Console sitemap SsrService canonical SEO"})`, 10 results; surfaced `7530ffa3-5d88-4ebe-980a-f91fe667082f` (`2026-10-16`), which noticed `/news/blog/blog/<slug>` in passing after `#19503` without filing the double-prefix bug in `collectBlogRoutes()`.
- `Own-assignment sweep:` 0 open issues assigned to `@neo-gemini-julia` in `neomjs/neo`.

## The Problem

1. In `apps/portal/resources/data/blog.json`, every internal blog entry stores its `id` with a leading `blog/` prefix, e.g.:
   ```json
   "id": "blog/where-an-agent-institution-sits"
   ```
2. In `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs:649` (`collectBlogRoutes`), the generator prepends `/news/blog/` directly onto `post.id`:
   ```js
   id: `/news/blog/${post.id}`
   ```
3. Likewise, in `apps/portal/view/news/blog/MainContainerController.mjs` and `apps/portal/view/news/blog/Component.mjs`, `/news/blog` is prepended onto `blog/<slug>` record IDs, emitting **doubled** `/news/blog/blog/<slug>` URLs in `sitemap.xml`, `content-routes.json`, `TreeList` links, and sibling blog markdown links (verified live on `https://neomjs.com/sitemap.xml`: `https://neomjs.com/news/blog/blog/where-an-agent-institution-sits`, `https://neomjs.com/news/blog/blog/a-workspace-that-can-leave-its-window`, etc.).

## The Architectural Reality

- `Design authority: "Extracts paths for Neo-hosted blog posts (those without a 'publisher' property, meaning they are hosted natively inside the Portal App rather than on external platforms like Medium)." (buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs:626-635)`
- Why `apps/portal/resources/data/blog.json` stores `"id": "blog/<slug>"`:
  - `Neo.app.content.Component#resolveContentId` (`src/app/content/Component.mjs:195`) computes `const segments = this.record.id.split('/').slice(0, -1)` so `"blog/<slug>"` provides the 1-folder depth inside `learn/` needed for `../guides/...` relative links inside `learn/blog/*.md` to resolve without escaping the root.
  - Therefore, `"id": "blog/<slug>"` must remain intact in `blog.json`, while `collectBlogRoutes()`, `Portal.view.news.blog.MainContainerController`, and `Portal.view.news.blog.Component#resolveContentId` normalize routes to `/news/blog/<slug>` and resolve `/news/blog/<slug>` (plus legacy `/news/blog/blog/<slug>`) back to the store's `blog/<slug>` records.

## The Fix

1. In `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs` (`collectBlogRoutes`):
   - Normalize `const slug = post.id.replace(/^blog\//, '');` before constructing `/news/blog/${slug}` so `sitemap.xml` and `content-routes.json` emit canonical `/news/blog/<slug>` URLs instead of `/news/blog/blog/<slug>`.
2. In `apps/portal/view/news/blog/MainContainerController.mjs` (`navigateTo`, `onRouteItem`):
   - Set `tree.routePrefix = '/news'` so `TreeList` leaf clicks (`${routePrefix}/${record.id}`) emit `/news/blog/<slug>`.
   - Strip leading `blog/` in `navigateTo(item)` and resolve `const slug = itemId.split('#')[0].replace(/^blog\//, ''), recordId = store.get(\`blog/\${slug}\`) ? \`blog/\${slug}\` : slug;` in `onRouteItem({itemId})`.
3. In `apps/portal/view/news/blog/Component.mjs` (`resolveContentId`):
   - Return `id.startsWith('blog/') ? \`news/\${id}\` : \`learn/\${id}\`` so sibling blog markdown links rewrite to `#/news/blog/<slug>`.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `collectBlogRoutes()` (`buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs:626-656`) | `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs` JSDoc | Strips leading `blog/` from `post.id` so emitted route `id` is `/news/blog/<slug>` | Handles `post.id` with or without leading `blog/` | JSDoc in `generate.mjs` | `Generate.spec.mjs` |
| `Portal.view.news.blog.MainContainerController` (`navigateTo`, `onRouteItem`) | `apps/portal/view/news/blog/MainContainerController.mjs` | Emits `/news/blog/<slug>`, sets `tree.routePrefix = '/news'`, and resolves `/news/blog/<slug>` to `store.get('blog/<slug>')` | Resolves both `/news/blog/<slug>` (with `#fragment`) and legacy `/news/blog/blog/<slug>` | JSDoc in `MainContainerController.mjs` | `MainContainerController.spec.mjs` |
| `Portal.view.news.blog.Component#resolveContentId` (`apps/portal/view/news/blog/Component.mjs:34-48`) | `apps/portal/view/news/blog/Component.mjs` JSDoc | Returns `news/${id}` when `id.startsWith('blog/')` so sibling blog links resolve to `#/news/blog/<slug>` | Non-blog `learn/` targets continue returning `learn/${id}` | JSDoc in `Component.mjs` | `BlogLinks.spec.mjs` |

## Decision Record impact

`none`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `collectBlogRoutes()` in `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs` strips any leading `blog/` prefix from `post.id`, emitting `/news/blog/<slug>` instead of `/news/blog/blog/<slug>`.
- [ ] `llms.txt` and `sitemap.xml` generation emit `/news/blog/<slug>` for all internal blog entries in `apps/portal/resources/data/blog.json`.
- [ ] Portal route `/news/blog/<slug>` resolves and renders the corresponding blog post in `apps/portal`.

## Out of Scope

- External blog posts (entries with `post.publisher` that link off-site).
- Sitemap ticket/PR dilution (tracked in sibling ticket `#20089`).

## Avoided Traps

- Do not strip `blog/` inside `blog.json` without checking whether `TreeList` or relative link resolution in `apps/portal/view/news/blog/Component.mjs` depends on `record.id` starting with `blog/`; normalizing the route in `generate.mjs`, `MainContainerController.mjs`, and `Component.mjs` preserves the 1-folder relative link depth inside `learn/`.
